title: Ya Ali Aapki Sarkar
body:
Ali Ali Ali
Sarkar ya Ali
Teri sarkar ya Ali

To hum dekh len
Ya Ali tere waris
Ka bharam dekh len
Jiske aane se badal jaayga ye jahaan
Inheen aankhon se wohi
Naqshe qadam dekh to Len
